title: Cyclotomic Log-Log Packet Growth
asymptotic_law: E[T_X] = Var(T_X) = log log X + C_cycl + o(1)
theorem_summary: The total split-prime valuation packet for Phi3(q) has exact finite-cutoff mean and variance Sum 2/(p-1), and by the prime number theorem in arithmetic progressions this globalizes to a unit-slope log-log growth law E[T_X]=Var(T_X)=log log X + C_cycl + o(1).
